title: ANVISA alert service migration completed
summary: On August 28, 2026, Brazil’s health regulator completed its move from an older service to its current safety-alert search service. Device safety alerts remain available in the app; no loss of current source coverage was identified. [Official ANVISA notice](https://www.gov.br/anvisa/pt-br/assuntos/noticias-anvisa/2026/antigo-portal-da-anvisa-e-sistec-serao-desativados-na-sexta-feira-28-8)
updates: ANVISA: the current safety-alert service remains available following the August 28, 2026 retirement of the older portal.
Switzerland: the national device-registration transition continues through December 31, 2026; no change was identified to publicly available field-safety notices.
no_major_changes: No significant availability or data-freshness changes were identified for FDA, BfArM, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada, PMDA, AEMPS, ANSM, or NMPA English safety information.
